[[File:MIkael Björnberg.pdf|thumb|PhD Mikael Björnberg 1965 – 2000]]

'''Mikael Björnberg''' (January 4, 1965 – November 17, 2000)<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Riska |first=Dan-Olof |date=3 December 2000 |title=Lahjakas tutkija keskittyi ydinjätekysymyksiin |url=https://www.hs.fi/ihmisia/art-2000003931129.html |journal=Helsingin Sanomat |url-access=subscription}}</ref> was a Finnish physicist. In 1995, he completed his doctoral degree with a dissertation in theoretical nuclear physics.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kangosjärvi |first=Jaakko |date=10 January 1995 |title=Väitökset |journal=Helsingin Sanomat}}</ref>

From 1997 to 1998, he was a visiting researcher at [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite journal |title=Kiihdytinavusteinen transmutaatio Los Alamosissa |journal=ATS Ydintekniikka |publisher=Atomtekniska Sällskapet i Finland) |publication-date=1997 |volume=26 |issue=3 |page=21}}</ref> Afterward, he was employed at the VTT [[VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland|Technical Research Centre of Finland]].<ref name=":0" /> He was Finland's representative on the [[OECD]] expert committee for nuclear waste.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Accelerator-driven Systems (ADS)and Fast Reactors (FR) in Advanced Nuclear Fuel Cycles A Comparative Study |publisher=Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) |publication-date=2002 |pages=315}}</ref>

Mikael Björnberg died in a plane crash in [[Hausjärvi]] at the age of 35.<ref name=":0" /> To honor his memory, the [[Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters]] established the [[PhD Mikael Björnberg Memorial Fund]] in 2002, which annually awards prizes to young outstanding theoretical physicists.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prizes and awards |url=https://scientiarum.fi/en/grants-and-prizes/prizes/ |access-date=14 November 2025 |publisher=Societas Scientiarum Fennica}}</ref> The prize was awarded for the first time in 2004.<ref>{{Cite book |title=SPHINX Årsbok – Vuosikirja – Yearbook 2003–2004 |publisher=Societas Scientiarum Fennica |year=2004 |editor-last=Holmberg |editor-first=Peter |location=Helsinki |pages=164}}</ref>
